text.zh: H11 HEPA过滤器，捕获99.97%过敏原

applications.zh: 家庭, 汽车, 办公室, 厨房

description.en:
Our UV mite removers combine powerful suction with UVC sterilization to eliminate dust mites, bacteria, and allergens from bedding, sofas, and carpets. The dual-function design kills 99.9% of mites while extracting dust and debris.

Features include 8W UVC lamp, 12000Pa strong suction, HEPA filtration to trap allergens, and a transparent dust cup for easy monitoring. The 400W motor and 5-meter power cord ensure thorough coverage of any room.

We provide OEM/ODM services including custom colors, branding, and packaging. MOQ 300 units, sample lead time 7-14 days.
description.zh:
我们的紫外线除螨仪结合强力吸尘与UVC杀菌，消除床品、沙发和地毯中的尘螨、细菌和过敏原。双功能设计在吸除灰尘碎屑的同时杀灭99.9%的螨虫。

功能包括8W UVC灯管、12000Pa强劲吸力、HEPA过滤网拦截过敏原，以及透明尘杯便于观察。400W电机和5米电源线确保彻底覆盖任何房间。

我们提供OEM/ODM服务，包括定制颜色、品牌和包装。最小起订量300台，样品交期7-14天。
